title: sesamum senecioides
intro: Sesamum senecioides, commonly known as the 'Wild Durian', is a plant species belonging to the family Pedaliaceae. It has been traditionally used in various cultures for its medicinal properties, which include treating fever, diarrhea, and respiratory issues.
